note: Scene bench (tools/renderer_scenes.py): maps with real rend2 content, visited at fixed viewpoints. Views are x y z yaw pitch from the rend2 comparison's view files. Packs are copied by name from the content source (env SCENE_CONTENT_SOURCE, or content_source here) into the bench's own content folder; the source's engine files are never copied or loaded.

best.note: Each renderer at its best on the rend2 content, layered on by_family. Both: 4x MSAA, 16x anisotropy. rend2 keeps the owner's preset. JKSunny PBR: every PBR feature it has, its 16-bit framebuffer (its r_hdr), bloom, deluxe specular. Builds before perf/vulkan 40d176ac0 rejected a whole material on rend2's q3gl2_sun (the grid sky): layer 'sunrewrite' for them. Owner 2026-10-09: parallax on in every comparison (JKSunny r_parallaxMapping 1 here, rend2's preset has it).

sunrewrite.note: For JKSunny builds before perf/vulkan 40d176ac0 (stock pbr, jksunny-pbr-perf 06e30f0c1): their parser rejects a whole material on q3gl2_sun, so the run gets copies of the materials with q3map_sunExt, the classic keyword with the same leading values (colour, intensity, yaw, elevation). Since 40d176ac0 q3gl2_sun parses and no rewrite is needed.

uncapped.note: No fps cap, to measure headroom (layer after best).

nosun.note: rend2 without the sun term and sun shadows, to measure their cost (layer after best).

gputimers.note: rend2 per-pass GPU timer printout every frame (r_speeds 100; candidate somaz-rend2-prof has the per-pass blocks). It reads the timers back synchronously, so frame times in this run are not comparable; read the breakdown with renderer_gpu_passes.py. rd-vulkan (jksunny-pbr-perf): r_gpuTimes 1 prints timestamps per render pass, read back two frames later without a stall.

noparallax.note: rend2 without parallax mapping, to measure its cost (layer after best).

latency2.note: perf builds: old frame queue (two frames in flight).

latency0.note: perf builds: wait for each frame before the next input.

oldparallax.note: perf build: original 16+8 step parallax everywhere.

oldglow.note: perf build: glow chain, depth copy and refraction pass always on.

urban_v2.note: siege_urban_pbr materials rebuilt by tools/pbr_heights.py build-urban: parallax only on materials with real relief, full-range heights, normal maps elsewhere. Override pack loaded from the run's homepath.

new_urban.note: Map pipeline 2026-10-09: the rebuilt zz_xen_rend2_urban.pk3 (build_urban.py with pbr_heights folded in), loaded over the bench's old copy for old/new screenshot pairs.

new_dantooine.note: Map pipeline 2026-10-09: the rebuilt zz_xen_rend2_dantooine.pk3 (build_dantooine.py with pbr_heights DANTOONINE_V2), loaded over the bench's old copy for old/new screenshot pairs.

new_illimiran.note: Map pipeline 2026-10-09: the rebuilt zz_xen_rend2_illimiran.pk3 (build_ctf_pbr.py --heights illimiran: parallax on 5 generated materials with traced relief), loaded over the bench's old copy for old/new screenshot pairs.

new_cyber.note: Map pipeline 2026-10-09: zz_xen_cyber_urban.pk3 re-assembled by build_cyber.py with pbr_heights CYBER_V2 (parallax on the four CP masonry materials), loaded over the bench's old copy for old/new screenshot pairs.

old_morning.note: Map pipeline trace fix 2026-10-09: the four map packs as they were before any pbr_heights work (morning backup, rend2_comparison/backups/20261009), loaded over the bench's current copy for old/fixed screenshot pairs.

nobloom.note: JKSunny without its bloom chain (rend2 has none).

nohdr.note: JKSunny with an 8-bit main target (its r_hdr 1 is 16-bit UNORM: precision, no range), dithered.

swap2.note: JKSunny r_swapchainImages 2 (perf/vulkan 46950287c+): two swapchain images without vsync.

decided.note: JKSunny with the owner's 2026-10-09 defaults (layer after best): bloom off, 8-bit targets (r_hdr 0) with dithering.

lmonly.note: Probe: lightmap only (r_lightmap 1) in both renderers, to compare the light each surface receives.

nocube.note: Probe: no cubemap reflections (r_cubeMapping 0) in both renderers.

nospec.note: Probe: no specular/physical maps (r_specularMapping 0) in both renderers.

npcs.note: Ghoul2 check (R3, R4): NPCs spawned in front of the urban start view (a spectator cannot spawn them: the player joins, spawns three, goes back to spectator), so Ghoul2 models are on screen with the sun cascades and the bone cache. Layer after best. Team changes are rate-limited (5 s), hence the long waits.

sunonly.note: Sun-only light for shadow comparisons (R4, layer after best): r_forceSun with map light scale 0 removes lightmap/grid light, cubemaps off; what remains is the sun term times the shadow value (and the sun's ambient in mode 1).

nonormal.note: Probe (R4): no normal maps (r_normalMapping 0) in both renderers.

noflares.note: Probe (R4): JKSunny without flare sprites (r_flares 0, rend2's default; JKSunny defaults to 1).

nocgshadows.note: Probe (R4): no cgame blob shadows (cg_shadows 0) in both renderers.

nossao.note: Probe (R4): SSAO off (r_ssao 0) in both renderers.

deluxeview.note: Probe (R4): rend2's deluxe map view (r_lightmap 3); JKSunny's light direction view is the dev build's r_sunShadowDebug 7.

nodlight.note: Probe (R4): JKSunny without dynamic lights (r_dynamiclight 0), for the black quads on Dantooine's cobble path.

clear.note: Probe (R4): JKSunny clears the colour buffer every frame (r_clear 1), so undrawn pixels show the clear colour.

noglow.note: Probe (R4): no dynamic glow (r_DynamicGlow 0) in both renderers.

nomsaa.note: Probe (R4): no MSAA in both renderers.

nodeluxe.note: Probe (R4): no deluxe mapping (r_deluxeMapping 0) in both renderers.

hidden.note: Owner 2026-10-09: look-only runs off the visible desktop, so the owner can keep working. The launcher moves the client window to y 12000 (below every monitor) within half a second of it appearing and hands the foreground back (vid_ypos alone left it at 0,0); no mouse grab. Not for timing: an off-screen window may present differently.

styledump.note: Probe (sun-once study, 2026-10-09): JKSunny dev build prints the final stages of every shader with lightmap styles (shaderlist styles; STYLESHADER/STYLESTAGE lines in the console log).

onesun.note: Sun once per surface (sun-once study, 2026-10-09): JKSunny r_sunStylePasses 0, rend2 perf r_sunStylePasses 0 (lightmap style layers add only their own lightmap light, as the vanilla renderer does).

stylesimple.note: Style-copy cost study (2026-10-09): JKSunny r_stylePassSimple 1, lightmap style passes without parallax, normal map or specular (perf/vulkan 69b5f9e12+).

manysun.note: rend2's per-style sun (sun-once study, 2026-10-09): r_sunStylePasses 1 in both perf builds, for comparisons after the default became 0.

dbglight.note: Probe (2026-10-13, police car): rd-vulkan r_sunShadowDebug 5 shows the light before the PI scale.

dbglm.note: Probe (2026-10-13, police car): rd-vulkan r_sunShadowDebug 11 shows the lightmap sample.

dbgvc.note: Probe (2026-10-13, police car): rd-vulkan r_sunShadowDebug 12 shows the vertex colour.

dbgnl.note: Probe (2026-10-13, police car): rd-vulkan r_sunShadowDebug 6 shows N.L of the baked light direction.

dbgl.note: Probe (2026-10-13, police car): rd-vulkan r_sunShadowDebug 7 shows the baked light direction L.

dev1.note: Probe (2026-10-13, police car): developer 1 logs rend2 stage collapsing per shader.

npcs_ffa1.note: Character shadows (2026-10-14): three NPCs at a mp/ffa1 spawn point with strong directed grid light, spawned as the npcs profile does; views from behind, the side and above. NPC AI frozen (d_npcfreeze 1) before the spawns so they stay in the views. Layer after best.

loadprof.note: Map load evaluation (2026-10-14): r_loadProfile 1 times the renderer's load phases from RE_LoadWorldMap (world, light directions, probe setup and bake, VBOs, images, pipelines); loadprofile prints them (LOADPROF lines) once the map is up. The whole load is the log from Server Initialization to the cgame's CL_InitCGame line.

charshadow_print.note: Character shadows (2026-10-14, r_charShadowFloor): print each caster's light, floor drop and reach once a second (r_charShadowDebug 2, no visual change). Layer last.

npcs_ctf_kejim.note: Character shadows (2026-10-14): three NPCs at a mp/ctf_kejim spawn point with strong directed grid light, spawned as the npcs profile does; views from behind, the side and above. NPC AI frozen (d_npcfreeze 1) before the spawns so they stay in the views. Layer after best. The NPCs fall from the spawn ledge to the floor below (about 1386 1664 1368, from r_charShadowDebug 2), where the views look.

npcs_ffa3.note: Character shadows (2026-10-14): three NPCs at a mp/ffa3 spawn point with strong directed grid light, spawned as the npcs profile does; views from behind, the side and above. NPC AI frozen (d_npcfreeze 1) before the spawns so they stay in the views. Layer after best.

charshadowprint.note: Character shadows (2026-10-14): print each caster's light once a second (r_charShadowDebug 2; layer after the candidate's own r_charShadows) and list the entities.

charshadowdbg3.note: Character shadows debug view 3 (r_charShadowDebug 3; see its cvar help). Layer after the candidate.

charshadowdbg4.note: Character shadows debug view 4 (r_charShadowDebug 4; see its cvar help). Layer after the candidate.

gputimes.note: GPU milliseconds per render pass every frame (r_gpuTimes 1, VKGPU lines in the console log; rd-vulkan). Layer last.

charshadowdump_kejim.note: Character shadows reference (2026-10-14): frame ctf_kejim's east view, then charshadowdump writes the casters (skinned, world space) and the camera and lights to home/base/charshadow/ for tools/charshadow_reference.py. Layer after npcs_ctf_kejim. Bloom, SSAO, dither and the cgame's blob shadow (cg_shadows 0) off so the debug view (r_charShadowDebug 1, overbright divided out) is the kept light, linear on screen.

charshadowdbg5.note: Character shadows debug view 5 (r_charShadowDebug 5: the first caster's receiver-to-blocker distance, 128 u white). Layer after the candidate.

charshadowhard.note: Character shadows without contact hardening (r_charShadowLightSize 0: no blocker search, fixed r_charShadowSoftness filter), for cost splits.

charshadowon.note: Character shadows on (r_charShadows 1) for a build whose default is off; layer after the map profile.

family_note: rend2 = the rend2 capture recipe's REND2_ON preset (HDR/tonemap off as there). Vulkan has no PBR path; r_pbrTextures 0 keeps PBR packs from replacing its diffuse textures where an engine gates them. Engines ignore cvars they do not have.
common_note: borderless 3840x2160 window on the main (4K, 240 Hz) monitor instead of exclusive fullscreen: unattended, a fullscreen client lost focus and rendered black at ~48 fps (2026-10-08)
